text: (1) of the Act provides that based on the recommendations of the SBB, the State Government may, from time to time, notify in the Official Gazette, areas of biodiversity importance as Biodiversity Heritage Sites under this Act. Further, the SBB shall consult the local body and BMC concerned before making such recommendations.
